briefs.claim_en: Prime Minister Modi is providing all Indians with 3 months of free mobile recharge.
briefs.brief_en: Multiple fact-checking organizations and news outlets, including The Quint (December 29, 2023), NewsOnAir (August 18, 2026), and NDTV (June 7, 2024), report that claims of Prime Minister Modi providing free mobile recharge for three months are false. These reports often cite PIB Fact Check, which has debunked such claims, stating that no such scheme has been announced by the Prime Minister or the central government. Some claims are associated with digitally altered videos or fraudulent links, sometimes linked to events like the 2024 Lok Sabha Elections or Raksha Bandhan.
